  • Method Details

    • createShape

      public static Shape createShape(com.google.gson.JsonElement json, long roiId)
      Create a Shape from a JSON element.
      Parameters:
      json - the JSON element containing the shape
      roiId - in OMERO, a ROI contains one or more shapes. This parameter is the ID of the ROI containing the shape to return
      Returns:
      a Shape corresponding to the provided JSON element
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided JSON object does not correspond to an expected shape
      com.google.gson.JsonSyntaxException - if the provided JSON object has an unexpected format
      RuntimeException - if the provided JSON object is null or lacks mandatory fields to create a shape

    • createShapes

      public static List<? extends Shape> createShapes(qupath.lib.objects.PathObject pathObject, boolean fillColor)
      Create a list of shapes from a PathObject.
      • If the ROI of the path object is a PointsROI, then a list of Point is returned.
      • If the ROI of the path object is a GeometryROI, then this ROI is split, and for each split ROI, a Polygon is created for the exterior ring and zero or more other Polygon are created for each interior ring.
      • Else, a corresponding shape is created (e.g. Ellipse from an EllipseROI).
      Parameters:
      pathObject - the path object to create the shape from
      fillColor - whether the created shapes should have a fill color
      Returns:
      a list of shapes corresponding to the provided PathObject
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided path object is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided path object contains an unexpected ROI
